design: BFS shortest-parent DAG, then ONE mutable reverse path with integer cursor stack; copy/reverse into output ONLY at beginWord leaf. No per-edge path copies; no recursion.

parameters.N: dictionary plus begin distinct vertex count, at most501
parameters.K: sum of answer path word counts
parameters.A: sum of answer word characters, equalsL*K
parameters.D: shortest ladder edge depth at mostN-1

time: Expected O(26*N*L^2+K), with standard hash-map lookup and amortized arrays; emission O(K), not O(K*D)
space: O(N+E+K+D+L) live space; L<=5 so O(parentGraph+output+depth)
